description: Schedule a post for a future time on one or more connected accounts. It can be cancelled with posts_cancel until it goes out.

content.description: The post. Needs text, an image, or both.

media.description: At most one image, by public URL.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key to retry without posting twice.

runAt.description: When to publish, as an ISO 8601 date-time in the future.

targets.description: Several accounts at once, each from accounts_list. Use instead of accountId/connectionId.

timezone.description: The user's IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Warsaw.

name: posts_schedule
title: Schedule a post
